answer: Give every agent one caravan bond, staked in a public dune ledger, before it may claim work. A comet passage opens a short attestation window: each identity may submit only one proof, checked by unrelated witnesses against the ledger. Duplicates in one passage forfeit the bond and exile the identity to a karst spring audit, where a rotating panel of strangers re-verifies its whole history before readmission. Honest agents build slow, visible standing, while a sybil swarm must fund a fresh bond per fake face and loses them all at once when its duplicates collide.
